title: Divide Two Integers
description: Given two integers, `dividend` and `divisor`, divide two integers without using multiplication, division, and modulo operators. The integer division should truncate toward zero. Handle potential overflow cases like `MIN_INT / -1`.

steps.note: Check for `MIN_INT / -1` overflow case. Not applicable here.
Determine if the result should be negative. `(10 < 0)` is false, `(3 < 0)` is false. `false !== false` is false. So, `is_negative` is false.
Set `abs_dividend` to absolute value of `dividend`. `Math.abs(10)` is 10.
Set `abs_divisor` to absolute value of `divisor`. `Math.abs(3)` is 3.
Outer `while` loop: `abs_dividend (10)` >= `abs_divisor (3)` is true. Enter loop.
Inner `while` loop: `abs_dividend (10) - temp_divisor (3)` (which is 7) >= `temp_divisor (3)` is true (7 >= 3). Double `temp_divisor` and `multiple`.
Inner `while` loop: `abs_dividend (10) - temp_divisor (6)` (which is 4) >= `temp_divisor (6)` is false (4 >= 6). Exit inner loop.
Outer `while` loop: `abs_dividend (4)` >= `abs_divisor (3)` is true. Enter loop.
Inner `while` loop: `abs_dividend (4) - temp_divisor (3)` (which is 1) >= `temp_divisor (3)` is false (1 >= 3). Exit inner loop.
Outer `while` loop: `abs_dividend (1)` >= `abs_divisor (3)` is false. Exit outer loop.
